mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM got_point WHERE deleted = 0) AS totalPoint, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM got_record WHERE DATE(check_time) = #{queryDate}) AS todayCheck, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM got_user WHERE status=1 AND role=2 AND deleted=0) AS normalUser, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM got_point WHERE deleted = 0 ) - ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT point_id) FROM got_record WHERE DATE(check_time) = #{queryDate} ) AS abnormalCount
SELECT DATE(check_time) AS dt, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM got_record WHERE DATE(check_time) >= DATE_SUB(#{queryDate},INTERVAL 29 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(check_time) ORDER BY dt ASC

SELECT u.id AS userId, u.username, u.nick_name AS nickName, COUNT(r.id) AS todayCheckCount FROM got_user u LEFT JOIN got_record r ON u.id = r.user_id AND DATE(r.check_time) = #{queryDate} WHERE u.role = 2 AND u.deleted = 0 GROUP BY u.id, u.username, u.nick_name ORDER BY todayCheckCount DESC
